text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Opposition DTA president Mishake Muyongo led a walkout of parliament on Tuesday in protest against the ruling SWAPO party's decision to bulldoze the Local Authorities Bill which provides for local elections to be held under a party list system instead of the current ward system.
- The Ministry of Works, Transport and Communication is setting up a commission of inquiry to investigate problems over the licensing and safety of aircraft in Namibia.
